title: Synthesis, biological activities and mechanistic studies of C(20)-ketone pachysandra alkaloids as anti-hepatocellular carcinoma agents.
authors: Zhao, JinFeng; Bai, Jing; Yu, Xiang; Zhang, WenWen; Zhao, ChenLiang; Ye, JiangHai; Wei, Peng; He, Kang; Zou, Juan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究C(20)-酮基富贵草生物碱的合成及抗肝癌活性，涉及JAK2/STAT3通路和分子对接，但核心是药物化学与细胞实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The pachysandra alkaloids found in Sarcococca ruscifolia demonstrate notable anti-hepatocellular carcinoma activity. Despite their efficacy, the structural diversity of these compounds remains limited, and their precise antitumor mechanism is still unclear. In pursuit of identifying novel lead compounds with high efficacy and low toxicity for combating hepatocellular carcinoma, twenty-three compounds of C(20)-ketone pachysandra alkaloid derivatives were designed and synthesized by using 3-dimethylamine pachysandra alkaloids as scaffolds. Subsequent in vitro anticancer activity experiments showed that synthetic pachysandra alkaloids had a stronger effect on HepG2 cells than did their natural counterparts, with low toxicity and high selectivity. The most potent derivative, 6k, had an IC(50) value of 0.75 muM, demonstrating 25.7-fold greater anticancer activity than sarcovagine D against HepG2 cells. Through network pharmacology and molecular docking analysis, it was revealed that synthetic pachysandra alkaloids may exert their effects by inhibiting the JAK2/STAT3 pathway, thereby preventing the proliferation of liver cancer cells. Further research through scratch tests, immunofluorescence experiments, and Western blot analysis revealed that compound 6k effectively inhibited the migration of HepG2 cells and induced mitochondria-mediated intrinsic apoptosis of HepG2 cells by regulating the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway. The aforementioned results indicate that compound 6k could be developed as a potential candidate for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma.
abstract_zh: 从Sarcococca ruscifolia中发现的富贵草碱（pachysandra alkaloids）显示出显著的抗肝细胞癌活性。尽管其有效，但这些化合物的结构多样性仍然有限，且其精确的抗肿瘤机制尚不清楚。为了寻找对抗肝细胞癌的高效低毒新型先导化合物，以3-二甲氨基富贵草碱为骨架，设计并合成了23种C(20)-酮基富贵草碱衍生物。随后的体外抗癌活性实验表明，合成的富贵草碱对HepG2细胞的作用强于其天然对应物，且具有低毒性和高选择性。最有效的衍生物6k的IC(50)值为0.75 μM，其对HepG2细胞的抗癌活性比sarcovagine D高25.7倍。通过网络药理学和分子对接分析，揭示合成富贵草碱可能通过抑制JAK2/STAT3通路发挥作用，从而阻止肝癌细胞的增殖。通过划痕实验、免疫荧光实验和Western blot分析的进一步研究表明，化合物6k有效抑制HepG2细胞的迁移，并通过调节JAK2/STAT3信号通路诱导HepG2细胞线粒体介导的内在凋亡。上述结果表明，化合物6k可开发为治疗肝细胞癌的潜在候选药物。
